sloka: लब्ध्वा भार्याम् कपिवरः प्राप्य राज्यम् सुहृत् वृतः ।ध्रुवम् नंदति सुग्रीवः संप्राप्य महतीम् श्रियम् ॥४-२७-२८॥
transliteration: labdhvā bhāryām kapivaraḥ prāpya rājyam suhṛt vṛtaḥ ।dhruvam naṁdati sugrīvaḥ saṁprāpya mahatīm śriyam ॥4-27-28॥

translations.english: 'Having obtained his wife, his kingdom and attained prosperity the monkey chief, Sugriva will be surely enjoying the company of friends and relatives'.
